LESSON: FEEDING THE FOUR THOUSAND

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus
Topic 3.4: Feeding the four thousand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Feeding the four thousand
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how to help those in need. 1. How did Jesus Christ show compassion?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand
2. practise the value of love by helping the needy

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: practise the value of love by helping the needy

Teach
• Today’s focus: practise the value of love by helping the needy.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “practise the value of love by helping the needy” using a school example.
• Model B for “practise the value of love by helping the needy” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "practise the value of love by helping the needy" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand
• Model 2: practise the value of love by helping the needy

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand
2. Practise: practise the value of love by helping the needy

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Feeding the four thousand.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to help those in need. 1. How did Jesus Christ show compassion?
2. Why should Christians help the needy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the miracle of feeding the four thousand
• practise the value of love by helping the needy

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
